_comment: Limits for scripts/lib/dictionary-guards.mjs. formCaps: most distinct word forms one entry may have, by part of speech (the story-scope maximum on 2026-09-23 was pron 18, num 15, adj 14, verb 12, noun 9). canaryDiffWords: how many of the most frequent story words may not gain a new lemma in an update. knownTags: form tags approved after an update introduced them.
